description: Prompt set for scripts/eval_agent_contract.py. Each entry is one realistic user request. kind is intent (one IntentBundle) or app (one AppBundle). expected_motifs, expected_action_kinds, expected_aesthetic_profile and expected_app_schema_version say what a correct answer declares; the report records whether the model met them.

prompts.prompt: Show a table of our recent orders with order id, customer, total, and status columns.
Build an inventory table of SKUs with name, quantity on hand, and reorder point, with a sort control on quantity.
I need a support ticket table with id, subject, priority, and assignee that I can search and filter by priority.
Render a paginated audit log table with timestamp, actor, action, and target.
A table of pending invoices with number, vendor, and amount where I can select several rows and approve them in bulk.
Create a sales dashboard with four KPI cards: revenue, orders, average order value, and refund rate.
An on-call operations dashboard showing uptime, open incidents, mean time to resolve, and remaining error budget, in a calm operations style.
A quarterly executive review dashboard with ARR, net revenue retention, gross margin, and headcount, styled for an executive review.
A dense metrics board for the data platform team: pipeline runs, failed jobs, rows processed, and freshness lag. Use the data-dense profile.
Present the employee handbook as an outline with three top-level sections and two or three subsections under each.
Lay out a twelve-week course syllabus as an outline of weekly topics with the readings listed under each week.
Compare our Starter, Team, and Enterprise plans on seats, storage, support level, and monthly price.
A side-by-side comparison of two laptop models on weight, battery life, display size, and price.
A list of the last five releases, each showing the version, the release date, and a one-line summary.
My task list with a title, a due date, and a done badge per task, plus a filter control that hides completed tasks.
A searchable list of contacts showing each person's name, company, and email.
A sign-up form with full name, work email, and password fields and a create account button.
A short customer feedback form with a rating field, a comments field, and a send button, in a warm organic style.
A shipping address form with street, city, postal code, and country fields and a continue button.
A customer detail page showing name, plan, signup date, lifetime value, and account owner as label and value pairs.
Show one incident's details: id, severity, status, opened at, and the on-call engineer.
The empty state for the projects page: a headline saying there are no projects yet, a short explanation, and a create project button.
An empty state for the search page when nothing matches the query, with a heading and a hint to try different words.
A loading state shown while the monthly report is generated, with a title and one line explaining the wait.
An error state for a failed payment: a heading, a message saying the card was declined, and a retry button.
A hero section announcing the launch of our analytics product with a headline, a subheading, and a get started button.
A premium SaaS landing hero for a billing platform: an eyebrow, a headline, supporting copy, and a request demo button.
A brutalist hero for an independent magazine issue with the issue number, the title, and a read now button.
A neon cyber styled hero for a hackathon: event name, date, tagline, and a register button.
A product page with a hero at the top and, below it, a table of supported integrations with name, category, and status.
An operations page with three KPI cards above a table of the latest deployments showing service, version, status, and time.
An order detail view with the order's summary fields and a list of its line items with product, quantity, and price.
An editorial product page: a hero with a headline and a subheading, followed by an outline of the product's chapters, in an editorial product style.
A two-screen internal support console: a ticket queue table and a ticket detail screen linked by static routes, with unbound fixture data.
An inventory manager app with a stock list screen and an item detail screen, bound read-only to fixture records so the proof checks that the fixture values are visible.
An approvals app where the queue screen's approve action updates state and the detail screen shows a banner only after an approval. It should run as a React app with visibility rules.
A knowledge base tool with a home screen listing articles and an article screen with a detail view, static routes only and no fixture binding.
A vehicle fleet app with a fleet overview dashboard screen and a vehicle detail screen, bound read-only to fixture vehicle records.
An onboarding checklist app where completing a step increments a counter shown as text on the checklist screen, plus a summary screen. Use interactive state with visibility rules.
